reason: Direct prefetched literal runs avoid staging copies. Per-coded-block extraction keeps large Huffman frames out of stored-block decoding. Repeated photo decode +2.65% relative to Rust png (unchanged reader +0.89%); format raw inflate +9.43% relative to flate2 (unchanged streaming inflate -0.60%). End-to-end format results are inconclusive. Shared-host measurements do not establish broad parity.

rejected.literal-batch: Variable-width memcpy flush regresses photo decode/inflate.
rejected.literal-copy: Constant-width staged copies increase code size without a convincing overall gain.
rejected.literal-run: Direct runs improve format inflate, but a longer stored-only case exposes a code-layout regression; select the per-block extraction instead.

scope: Decoder-only work. 24 normal groups, eight longer focus groups and four stored-only groups; 108 timed processes. Pipeline-byte fields are invariant checks, not peak-memory measurements. Full validation and ASan evidence are linked by the finalizer.
